cohort: The study included 48 feline obstetric emergencies presented to University Veterinary Hospital, Mannuthy, Kerala during the calendar year 2021.
finding: Maternal factors were responsible for 75.56% of feline dystocia, while foetal factors accounted for 24.44%, with medical management successful in 45.71% and surgical management adopted in 48.89% of emergency cases.
mod_finding: Surgical management was adopted in 48.89% of obstetric emergency cases, indicating its frequent use for difficult deliveries.
